instruction:
Fix `packages/element/src/pages.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 security fixes. Add three exports to this file; other packets in this round import them by these exact names. Change nothing else except the one line in step 4.

1. `export const MAX_REMOTE_PAGES = 1000;` and `export const sanitizeRemotePages = (value: unknown): ExcalidrawPage[]`. Page records from collaborators and Firestore are untrusted. Return [] when value is not an array. Otherwise keep only records that are non-null objects with: `id` a non-empty string; `name` a string of at most MAX_PAGE_NAME_LENGTH characters; `index` passing isValidPageIndex; `version`, `versionNonce` and `updated` finite numbers; `isDeleted` a boolean. Drop any other entry, keep the first of duplicate ids, stop at MAX_REMOTE_PAGES records, and return new objects holding exactly those seven keys so nothing extra travels on. Never assign indices and never add a default page: an empty result must stay empty, which is the legacy-room contract.

2. `export const dropDeletedPageElements = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(elements: readonly T[], pages: readonly ExcalidrawPage[]): readonly T[]`. Return elements without those whose getElementPageId is the id of a page record with isDeleted true. An element on an unknown page is kept. With no tombstoned page, return the same array.

3. `export const getPageViewport = (pageViewports: Readonly<Record<string, PageViewport>> | undefined, pageId: string): PageViewport | undefined`. Read own properties only, with `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call`, so a page id such as `constructor` never returns an inherited value.

4. In scopeAppStateToActivePage, replace `viewports[active.id]` with `getPageViewport(viewports, active.id)`.

Fix `packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 security fix, Low: page ids are used as plain-object keys. A crafted file with a page id of `constructor` gets an inherited function from `pageViewports[activePageId]`, and the viewport breaks.

1. At `appState.scrollX === undefined ? pageViewports[activePageId] : undefined`, use `getPageViewport(pageViewports, activePageId)`, exported from @excalidraw/element.

Do not use Object.create(null): the value must stay a plain object, because snapshots print it. Change nothing else.
